evidence: Name/slug: task.toml:5 name = "turing/hireops-recruiting-operations"; manifest.json task = projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations, so name == turing/<dirname> (quality-checks.md #8 Verify; staged-task-contract.md:41). Slug has 3 hyphen tokens (consistent with check-task-slug.sh). The frozen snapshot dir 'task' is not an identity defect per the assignment. Frozen task.toml sha256 ac664d0e... equals the live project's task.toml. Description (task.toml:6) names this product's axes: shared pipeline board, recruiter-candidate conversations, concurrent multi-user correctness - matching instruction.md (board, conversations, 'several of us have it open at once') and hireops_rules.md sections 3, 5, 6. Keywords (task.toml:7) recruiting/pipeline/messaging/realtime + webdev/turing/full-stack fit (realtime = 15-second live updates, rules section 5). difficulty_explanation (task.toml:11) lists one-step moves, interview capacity, role rules, stale-move 409 refusal with who, all-or-nothing bulk moves, undo only while untouched, per-person unread/seen, paged history keeping place, drafts surviving reload and ended session, live updates not disturbing typing/focus/scroll, candidate data isolation - every item is a public requirement in instruction.md or hireops_rules.md (sections 3, 5, 6, 7); none is a hidden/golden-only demand (lesson 1). difficulty = hard, category = programming, tags template-standard, provenance ('Adapted from the supplied HireOps task ... authored reference implementation and browser rubric') and arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' all describe the same recruiting task. Every template CHANGE_ME placeholder is replaced; non-identity settings are byte-identical to the template. Cross-file identity agrees: app_context.md 'Name: HireOps', package.json name 'hireops', index.html <title>HireOps recruiting workspace</title>, prompts reference HireOps accounts/jobs. Drift check (lessons 17/18): the branch history mentions a 'live change desk' and change-set files are deleted in the working tree; the frozen task contains no change desk/change-set/compensation strings and the metadata does not claim one, so metadata matches the current candidate rather than a prior version. No Colderwater or other-task leftovers. Minor observations, not defects: (a) staged-task-contract.md:42 comment suggests the description may mention 'judge, dimension policy'; the authoritative workbook row and quality-checks.md #8 only require naming the product and its actual axes, and the frozen template supplies CHANGE_ME, so omission is not a failure; (b) difficulty_explanation attaches 'undoable only while untouched' to bulk moves while the rules make single moves undoable too - a summary simplification, not a contradiction. Counterexample attempts: no plausible broken app or conforming alternative is graded differently because of identity metadata; this row is metadata-only and has no runtime component, so no runtime evidence is required for it.
